Potato Broccoli Casserole
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 5, 2009 - 11:26pm

Ingredients




1 (2 lb.) bag frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
1/4 cup butter
1/4 cup chopped onion
1 teaspoon salt
1/4 teaspoon pepper
1 (8 oz.) pkg. grated cheddar cheese
1 (8 oz.) sour cream
1 (10 oz.) cream of chicken soup

Preparation

1 Mix above ingredients. Cook 2 packages frozen broccoli spears or 1 bunch fresh. Mix together 1/2 cup corn flakes, crushed and 2 tablespoons butter. Set aside. Place half of potato mixture in buttered casserole. Place broccoli on top. Add remaining potato mixture. Sprinkle corn flake crumbs on top. Bake covered at 350 degrees until hot.
